title: Lush Chinese-Style Cabbage Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious stir-fry recipe featuring cabbage, inspired by Chinese cuisine. Can be served as a side dish or a light lunch.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of lush in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced cabbage and cook until it starts to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon each of tagine and egyptian to the skillet.
Stir-fry the cabbage for an additional 2-3 minutes, until it reaches your desired level of tenderness.
Serve hot, garnished with extra lush if desired.
